notes.title: Announcement of a delay to Chapter Two
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39609849/97066ca6df83f117a28f28c58bf03eaa4fcffc79.png[/img]

We would like to preface by saying, on behalf of everyone working on Stories of Liane, we greatly appreciate your support and feedback for Chapter One. All of the feedback has been generally positive and we are thankful for all of the responses we have received. 

In response to some challenges we are facing and some of the feedback we have received, we are announcing that [b]Stories of Liane Chapter Two will be delayed by at least six months. [/b]

We feel like this is a necessary step to ensure that the quality of Chapter Two meets exceeds the bar set by Chapter One. We are greatly considering the story and where we want it to go based of the feedback we received. Another improvement we want to make is on the technical side of things. It is very important to us that we ensure that the game runs smoothly and is a consistent experience for every player, regardless of specs. In addition to working on the quality of the game, we all have full time jobs that we are also trying to maintain, which adds some unforeseen complications. This game is completely being built in our free time because we love making games, and that is what we will continue to do,

We will be attempting to provide an update on the production on the 1st of every month starting August 1st to share the progress we are making and take feedback from the community. We believe this will provide the most transparency about where the game is headed and give the community a way to discuss the game with developers so we can create an awesome experience. 

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Chapter 01 v0.1.4
notes.content: Fixed major performance, experience, and level design bugs.

notes.title: Patch v0.1.3 - New Autosave and Bug Report Feature
notes.content:
[b]Autosave Feature[/b]
At key moments, the game will automatically save for the unfortunate situations where a bug is stopping you from advancing further, you can use the load save feature in the main menu to load an auto or manual save. 

[b]Bug Report Feature[/b]
You can now submit a bug report from the game. By holding Ctrl and pressing B on keyboards or holding Left Shoulder and pressing Right Shoulder to activate and deactivate the bug report window. Press the load button ONCE and fill out the form to submit. You can then make a bug report, see what other bugs have been found in the area by others or yourself, and more! All data is saved in a Trello board and will be evaluated by the team. 

[b]Major and Minor Bug Fixes and Optimizations[/b]

notes.title: Stories of Liane Patch v0.1.2b (Subtitle & Minor Bug Fixes Update)
notes.content:
[b]Subtitles[/b]
Subtitles are now a default setting in the game, though there is currently no setting to turn them off. 

[b]Various Minor Bug and Performance Fixes[/b]

[b]Bug with extreme sensitivity[/b]
Unfortunately, we have not been able to track down this issue. However, if you experience a scenario where the sensitivity is extreme, you may need to disable Steam Controller settings. We are working on hunting down the cause of this issue.

As always, if you experience any issues, feel free to let us know! Thank you for your feedback!

notes.title: Stories of Liane v0.1.2
notes.content:
[b]Better controller support[/b]
Enhanced control scheme for controller players. The project should be completely controllable with a gamepad with the exception of a known bug where the controller cannot control the pause/main menu. 

[b]Reduced storage size[/b]
Removed the future update game files and optimized the remainder of the files. This results in ~65% reduced file size. Stories of Liane is now 7.65 GB at the moment. 

[b]Fixed user experience for terminals[/b]
Terminals now reset the user's cursor position when approaching the device. This should get rid of most of the bugs that have been popping up where users were unable to use the terminals. We are monitoring the issue to see if it still occurs, but if you experience it after this patch, please let us know so we can look into it. 

[b]Added a manual save option[/b]
Players can now quicksave using Tab or Gamepad Left Special Button, then go to the pause menu to reload the last quicksave. Using this feature will reset all of the player's variables to when the save was created. 

[b]Expanded the pause menu[/b]
The player can now view more information in the pause menu including a resume game button, a settings button (which includes graphical setting options and control scheme), a reload quicksave button, and an area where the last code found is displayed. 

[b]Optimized lighting and effects[/b]
Performance has been an issue at launch. A small step to improvement has been to greatly optimize lighting and effects. Performance should make a small improvement with this update, and there will be more to come. 

[b]Skip intro option[/b]
For replayability, users can skip the intro by pressing Esc or Gamepad Right Special Button and selecting 'Skip Intro'.


[i]Thank you very much for the feedback! We will continue to improve the game and begin working on Chapter Two![/i]

notes.title: Stories of Liane Chapter One Releasing March 1st
notes.content:
Chapter One of Stories of Liane will be launching in two days and we are really excited to share with you the work we have been building. The response and feedback from everyone have been really inspiring and we thank you for the support. We wanted to take some time to talk about the setting the game takes place in as well as what to expect. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39609849/107aa7d4d3c8acc1abe0ec4eb76f16737b8d979a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39609849/7c22d01be3752808b6caa8e851faadb46569c018.png[/img]

Nearly a century into the future, Earth has died, and corporations have built vessels to continue humanity and search for a new home. With only a few tens of thousands of humans left, a new space race has begun, a race for which corporation finds a home for humanity first. A winner take all scenario. These are the stories that will be explored in Stories of Liane. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39609849/21d6490ff3024630caabd3976bda7dfbf5cb0fb3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39609849/ea0585b2fd58f68de8b6d6cead3bf1987945926b.png[/img]

A corporate vessel, known as the Kaleidoscope Center of Research has gone missing with its last known coordinates being in an uncharted section of the galaxy. Anna Liane, a private investigator, is sent to investigate and she finds the ship crashed on the uncharted planet known as Di'Zhu. While she has a job to do, she also has an alternative motive. Her sister, Allison Liane, was working on the ship when it went missing. Anna's desire to learn the truth of what happened pushes her forward into the abyss. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39609849/2d5bc0e9bb88db5630631a32ac54eb56786b0c99.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39609849/761516aef4a816d71597b16d8f5b18719e1feef2.png[/img]

Stories of Liane is going to be a collection of short stories that take place in different parts of the universe with different settings and different characters to explore. Each will feature a slightly different gameplay style and challenge to accomplish the goals based on the narrative that is being told and the characters you will be controlling. Each story is about 15-20 minutes of gameplay, with a launch plan to release three 15-20 minute stories and one major story (30-45 minutes) to tie the plotline together. We hope you like this experimental project, it is an absolute blast to make. If you have any questions, feel free to leave a message on the discussion board and we will get back to you as soon as we can. 

We'll see you starside. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39609849/c476023eb81563b48afcc21a2659b134a53f2f37.png[/img]
